placements.title: From synchronous calls to async job contracts
placements.theme: System design decisions that shape how the agent runtime dispatches, tracks, and retrieves work.

placements.title: Remember dispatches async, returns a receipt, and retrieves by poll or piggyback
placements.theme: The async job contract makes `remember` non-blocking: dispatch returns a receipt in seconds, extraction is watched by polling a cursor, and the agent either polls the run or gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call — no blocking, no lost work if the receipt is dropped.
placements.why: All three segments cohere around the ratified async job contract: src-1 states the contract (receipt in seconds, extraction watched by polling a cursor), src-2 asserts its operational guarantees (no blocking call, no lost work if the receipt is dropped), and src-3 records the dispatch-and-retrieval decision (remember dispatches, agent polls or gets the reaction piggybacked). No existing leaf holds this theme; the grain test admits it — future envelopes will keep feeding the async contract's design and guarantees.
